meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发前的调研与访谈整理成可直接执行的编码方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到编程任务时希望先彻底理清需求再动手写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn pre-coding research into an executable development plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, approved plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求先做规划时，Claude 会以“规划顾问”身份只读探索代码库，把模糊需求整理成一份决策完整的分步工作计划（含任务清单与验证项），写入 .omo/ 目录；在用户明确批准前不会编写或修改任何产品代码。
howto.when: 仅在用户明确说出“ulw-plan”“plan mode”等指令，或主动要求在编码前制定工作计划时触发；平时不会自动启动。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 帮我把这个需求变成工作计划。
say.note: 进入规划模式，先探索代码库。

say.text: 先别写代码，规划一下这个功能怎么做。
say.note: 会提几个关键问题，等确认后再出方案。

say.text: 进入规划模式，拆解整个改版并给出任务清单。
say.note: 批准后才会生成计划文档。

howto.what_en: When the user asks for planning first, Claude acts as a read-only planning consultant, grounds in the codebase, and turns a vague or large request into ONE decision-complete work plan (task list plus verification wave) under .omo/. It never edits product code or implements before explicit approval.
howto.when_en: Activates only on an explicit user request: saying ulw-plan / plan mode, or asking for a work plan before coding in their own words. It never self-activates on a plain run or agent-side routing.

say_en.text: Turn this feature request into a work plan with ulw-plan.
say_en.note: Enters plan mode and explores the codebase.

say_en.text: Don't code yet; plan how to build this feature first.
say_en.note: Asks key questions, then waits for approval.

say_en.text: Enter plan mode and break the refactor into task items.
say_en.note: Writes the plan only after your okay.
